answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to claim a paid slot, an identity burns 40 POA; the receipt is cipher-signed, so one receipt never opens two slots. It becomes a ferrous badge in a quartz ledger of time-stamped entries. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 POA against about 200 POA of rewards, a guaranteed 3,800 POA loss. A rented badge fails: bound to the signing cipher key, it voids on audit. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot 20 epochs, undiluted.
